name: Flippy Bit
description: An arcade game after Q42's Flippy Bit and the Attack of the Hexadecimals from Base 16: invaders fall carrying a number in hex, and you flip eight bits until they spell it. Keys 1 to 8 (or tap). It speeds up until one lands. Score = invaders shot down ÷ target.

fields.name: note
fields.description: Optional line shown above the game.

fields.name: base
fields.description: The base the invaders' numbers are written in: 16 (hex), 10, 8 or 2.

fields.name: speed
fields.description: How fast invaders fall and arrive. 1 is the original pace, 0.5 half, 2 double.

fields.name: target
fields.description: Invaders shot down in one run that earn full credit.

fields.name: hints
fields.description: Show each bit's place value under it and the number the bits spell right now.

fields.name: sound
fields.description: 8-bit sound effects (can also be toggled in the game).
